listing.title: My First Fruits & Veggies Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Smiling Fruits and Vegetables – Apples, Bananas, Carrots, Broccoli & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a happy first book of fruits and vegetables!

Thirty smiling foods are waiting for little artists, from juicy strawberries and bananas to crunchy carrots and broccoli. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines, so small hands can color inside the lines and learn the names of everyday foods.

Inside you'll find:

  • 30 cheerful fruits and vegetables: apple, banana, strawberry, orange, pear, cherries, grapes, pineapple, watermelon, lemon, peach, kiwi, mango, blueberries, coconut, carrot, broccoli, corn, tomato, cucumber, pepper, eggplant, pumpkin, potato, mushroom, peas, onion, radish, avocado and lettuce
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines, made for crayons and chunky markers
  • Each food's name in big letters on every page, to color and to learn first words
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5, and a playful way to talk about food at home.

Part of the my first step series. Also try My First Animals Coloring Book and My First Trucks Coloring Book.
